name: Cod Curry en Papillote with Kashmiri Chilli
description: Fresh cod fillets spiced with Kashmiri chilli, cumin, ginger, and coconut oil, sealed in parchment and steam-baked. A curated fusion of Pakistani spice logic and French en papillote technique.
keywords: cod curry en papillote, baked cod curry, fish en papillote curry, kashmiri cod recipe, halal fish recipe, French technique Pakistani spice
recipeIngredient: 20 g fresh ginger, peeled and cut into matchsticks
2 medium tomatoes, finely diced (about 180 g total)
1 small red onion, halved and thinly sliced
4 tsp coconut oil (to finish, one per parcel)
2 tbsp fresh coriander leaves, roughly torn

recipeInstructions.name: Preheat oven
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C (400°F / Gas 6). Ensure it is fully up to temperature before the parcels go in.

recipeInstructions.name: Make the spice paste
recipeInstructions.text: In a small bowl, combine the melted coconut oil, Kashmiri chilli powder, cumin, coriander, turmeric, salt, and lemon juice. Stir until it forms a loose, even paste.

recipeInstructions.name: Coat the fish
recipeInstructions.text: Pat the cod fillets dry with kitchen paper. Coat each fillet all over with the spice paste and leave for 10 minutes at room temperature.

recipeInstructions.name: Cut parchment
recipeInstructions.text: Cut four sheets of parchment paper, each approximately 40 × 30 cm (16 × 12 inches).

recipeInstructions.name: Build each parcel
recipeInstructions.text: In the centre of each parchment sheet, layer red onion, diced tomato, garlic slices, ginger matchsticks, two curry leaves, and a quarter of the green chilli.

recipeInstructions.name: Add fish and finish
recipeInstructions.text: Place a cod fillet on top of the aromatics. Add one lemon slice, drizzle over 1 tsp coconut oil, and scatter torn coriander leaves.

recipeInstructions.name: Seal the parcel
recipeInstructions.text: Bring the long edges of parchment up over the fish and fold together in tight, overlapping pleats. Fold or twist the short ends closed firmly to hold in the steam.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Bake for 18–20 minutes. Do not open the parcels during cooking.

recipeInstructions.name: Rest and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Rest the parcels for 2 minutes on a board. Open at the table, finish with flaky sea salt and fresh coriander leaves.
